member.summary: Updates a single column in the persistent spectrogram bitmap using bitmap shifting.
member.param: Normalized magnitude values [0, 1] for the new column, one per frequency bin.
member.remarks:
This is the core optimization that transforms the renderer from O(width × height) to O(width + height): 1. Shifts all existing columns left by one pixel (O(width) pixel copies) 2. Draws the new column at the rightmost position (O(height) rectangle draws)
